from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Synthesis and Application", [
            "Slopes transform into area evaluations.",
            "Geometric problems become simple subtraction.",
            "Synthesis reveals calculus's fundamental bridge."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture_texts[0].set_color("#ffffff")
        
        # Complex system diagram nodes
        nodes = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.3, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.3) for _ in range(4)])
        self.place_at_grid(nodes[0], 'B2')
        self.place_at_grid(nodes[1], 'B5')
        self.place_at_grid(nodes[2], 'E2')
        self.place_at_grid(nodes[3], 'E5')
        
        connections = VGroup(
            Line(nodes[0].get_center(), nodes[1].get_center()),
            Line(nodes[1].get_center(), nodes[3].get_center()),
            Line(nodes[3].get_center(), nodes[2].get_center()),
            Line(nodes[2].get_center(), nodes[0].get_center())
        )
        self.add(connections, nodes)
        self.play(Create(nodes), Create(connections))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture_texts[0].set_color(GRAY)
        self.lecture_texts[1].set_color("#ff4081")
        
        # Signal flow (glowing pulse)
        pulse = Circle(radius=0.1, color="#ff4081", fill_opacity=1)
        self.add(pulse)
        for i in range(len(connections)):
            self.play(MoveAlongPath(pulse, connections[i]), run_time=0.8)
        self.remove(pulse)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture_texts[1].set_color(GRAY)
        self.lecture_texts[2].set_color("#ffc107")
        
        # Highlight final result (gold square)
        result_box = Square(color="#ffc107", stroke_width=4)
        self.place_in_area(result_box, 'B2', 'E5')
        self.play(Create(result_box))
        
        self.wait(2)
